chalisa.do1: Bowing my head at the feet of Śrī Gaṇapati and holding Śāradā in meditation in my heart, I recount the whole glory of Mother Santoṣī.
chalisa.cau1: Victory to you, Mother Santoṣī, mother of the world, destroyer of the hosts of cruel, evil-minded demons. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Lord Gaṇapati is your father, and Ṛddhi and Siddhi are called your mother. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You are the darling of your mother and father; how am I to tell your glory? ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: On your head is a diadem, peerless and grand; the beauty of the earrings in your ears is matchless. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Your limbs shine with a lovely radiance and grace; you wear a beautiful golden garment. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: You are four-armed, graceful and majestic, and you wear a garland of forest flowers about your neck. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: Near you is a cow, dear beyond measure, and you ride a peacock. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: All know your sovereign power; gods, men and sages all sing your praise. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: Mother, the moment one has sight of you, all sorrow and poverty perish. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: The Vedas and Purāṇas have been singing your glory; you come to the help of your devotee. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Beside Brahmā you were called Sarasvatī, and in the form of Lakṣmī you came to Viṣṇu's side. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Beside Śiva you took your seat in the form of Girijā; your glory resounded through the three worlds. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: You appeared in the form of Śakti, as people know; in the form of Rudra you became Mother Bhavānī. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: To crush the wicked you appeared as Kālī, a blazing light, fierce and wondrous. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: You slew Caṇḍa, Muṇḍa and Mahiṣāsura, and struck down the demons Śumbha and Niśumbha. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: The Vedas and Purāṇas have described your glory; you take away the troubles of your own devotees. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: In the form of Śāradā you are the enchantress with the swan; formless and with form, you are favourable. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: You have spread your māyā in all four directions; your splendour fills every particle. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: The earth, the sun, the moon and the stars are all bound in their order at your sign. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: You alone sustain and nourish, and in a fleeting moment you take away life. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Brahmā and Viṣṇu meditate on you daily; Śeṣa and Maheśa keep their minds fixed on you always. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: You fulfil the heart's desires, cut away sin and carry one across the fear of worldly existence. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: The man who meditates on you with his mind fixed on you gains happiness and wealth. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: Childless women who meditate on you gain a son, as a creeper bears a flower. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: A woman parted from her husband is in great distress; you are the help of those sorely distressed by separation. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: Any maiden who meditates on you gains the husband her heart desires. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: You are gentle and virtuous, Mother, the one who rows your own people's boat across. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: Whoever keeps your vow according to the rite, you fill with boundless happiness and wealth. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: An offering of jaggery and gram pleases you; whoever serves you gains joy. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: Those who hold you in meditation with faith surely cross over worldly existence. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: Whoever performs the udyāpana, the rite that completes your vow, you deliver with ease. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: The married woman who keeps your vow fills her lap with happiness and wealth. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: With whatever feeling a man remembers you, such is the fruit he gains. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: Whoever keeps in mind the vow of seven Fridays has all his wishes fulfilled. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: Whoever serves you with devotion has his poverty and sorrow taken away. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Mother, whoever comes to your refuge, you accomplish his work in a moment. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Victory, victory, victory to you, Ambā, the auspicious one. Have mercy on me, great queen. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Whoever reads this Chālīsā of the Mother, on him the Lord of the world bestows his grace. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: The man who recites it once every day remains dear to you. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: At the taking of your name all ailments flee, and no disease or fault ever touches him. ॥40॥
chalisa.do2: Night and day I bow always at the feet of Mother Santoṣī. May all my wishes be fulfilled; Mother, take away the terror of worldly existence.
